creation.prompt: Edit the owner-selected transparent Leo+Milo paired pose in reference 1. After the L010 release: Leo stays lying with head/chest raised, his blocking FRONT paw withdrawn nearer his own chest so the ground route ahead of Milo is visibly clear. Show clearly gentle reassuring eyes/down-right, relaxed brows and a small kind closed-mouth smile; no surprised wide eyes or startled brows. Milo remains on the same viewer-right ground root/depth, looking up-left in quiet relief and dawning trust, easing nervous brows rather than surprised wide eyes; do not make him leave, step backward, change size or switch sides. Preserve Leo trunk/hips/rear paws/tail, and preserve Milo head/ear/torso/limb ratios. No paw pressing/covering Milo. Leo remains lying; never stands fully. Preserve the same pair canvas, Leo-left/Milo-right screen axis, intrinsic felt palette, grey Milo paws, cream patch, green mouse eyes, amber lion eyes, mane curls and animal-specific proportions. References 2/3 own respective canonical identities; 4/5 are their own visible measurement guides, never paint guides or apply mouse ratios to lion. No independent head/body resizing. Milo upright projected head fraction 0.39 +/-0.01 applies only at compatible upright pitch; bent/occluded views require comparison, not a fabricated pass. Both mouths closed and toothless. Keep complete characters with margins, genuine transparent alpha, no environment, ground plane, cast shadows, props, symbols, words or watermark. Exactly one output.

inputs.authority: exact shared body projection and relative scale; only requested acting/front-paw change
